title: Plan an offline-first field-notes synchronization change

criteria.description: Design respects the revision/409 API and team authorization. Preserves offline drafts and handles conflicts explicitly without silent overwrites, claiming unavailable batch APIs, or inventing server idempotency.

Concrete flows cover interrupted/duplicated saves, retry/backoff, storage failure, two-device edits and membership revocation. Explains what is persisted, acknowledged and retried and identifies unresolved API/product choices.
Small sequenced plan names verification scenarios, tradeoffs, monitoring, feature gating and rollback with draft preservation. No unnecessary infrastructure; concise, actionable handoff.
